items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: His name was Leonel. They all called him Buddy. Buddy was his nickname.

ctx.x: Okay. And your husband -- second husband's last name was Lewis, but what was his first name?
His name was Leonel. They all called him Buddy. Buddy was his nickname.
And your son, you told me on the tape we did over, but we didn't repeat it, he was born at 6-1/2 months and he weighed 2-1/4 pounds.
